points.description: Identifies a defensible overall organizational pattern, such as problem-and-solution, cause-and-effect, or a sequence that defines space junk, explains how it is created and why it is dangerous, then discusses responses/solutions.

Supports the identified organization with at least one relevant detail from the article, such as the section headings, the 2009 satellite collision creating debris, the lost tool bag, the damage caused by high-speed fragments, or the catalogues and reinforced spacecraft/spacesuits used to address the problem.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both a reasonable description of how the article is organized and at least one supporting detail from the text. Award partial credit only if one of these two elements is present. Equivalent wording and other valid organizational descriptions earn the marks.
